description: Use to poll a previously created approval by auth_req_id (e.g. after logi__request_approval with wait_for_decision=false or a 'timeout'). Read-only. Returns current status and (when terminal) the decision metadata. Only status 'approved' means proceed. Prefer logi__request_approval with wait_for_decision=true unless you specifically need non-blocking polling.
name: logi__check_approval
